function borderCase(variant) {
  document.body.innerHTML='';
  document.body.style.cssText='margin:0';
  document.documentElement.style.fontSize='20px';
  const checks={};
  const close=(a,b)=>Math.abs(a-b)<0.001;
  const make=(css,parent=document.body)=>{
    const box=document.createElement('div');
    box.style.cssText=`width:${20+variant}px;height:10px;${css}`;
    parent.append(box);return box;
  };
  const boxCheck=(name,css,horizontal,vertical)=>{
    const box=make(css), r=box.getBoundingClientRect();
    checks[name]=close(r.width,20+variant+horizontal)&&close(r.height,10+vertical);
    box.remove();
  };
  boxCheck('initial','',0,0);
  boxCheck('solid','border:2px solid red',4,4);
  boxCheck('transparent','border:2px solid transparent',4,4);
  boxCheck('currentColor','color:blue;border:2px solid currentColor',4,4);
  boxCheck('colorOnly','border-color:red',0,0);
  boxCheck('widthOnly','border-width:9px',0,0);
  boxCheck('none','border:9px none red',0,0);
  boxCheck('hidden','border:9px hidden red',0,0);
  boxCheck('styleOnly','border-style:solid',6,6);
  boxCheck('thin','border:thin solid',2,2);
  boxCheck('medium','border:medium solid',6,6);
  boxCheck('thick','border:thick solid',10,10);
  boxCheck('negativeLiteral','border:2px solid;border-width:-3px',4,4);
  boxCheck('negativeShorthand','border:2px solid;border:-3px dashed red',4,4);
  boxCheck('negativeMember','border:2px solid;border-width:1px -3px 4px',4,4);
  boxCheck('zero','border:0 solid',0,0);
  boxCheck('small','border:.01px solid',2,2);
  boxCheck('fraction','border:2.9px solid',4,4);
  boxCheck('one','border:1.9px solid',2,2);
  boxCheck('negativeCalc','border:calc(1px - 2px) solid',0,0);
  boxCheck('twoWidths','border-style:solid;border-width:2px 4px',8,4);
  boxCheck('threeWidths','border-style:solid;border-width:2px 4px 6px',8,8);
  boxCheck('fourWidths','border-style:solid;border-width:2px 4px 6px 8px',12,8);
  boxCheck('mixedStyles','border-width:4px;border-style:none solid hidden dashed',8,0);
  for(const style of ['dotted','dashed','double','groove','ridge','inset','outset'])
    boxCheck(style,`border:3px ${style}`,6,6);
  boxCheck('em','font-size:10px;border:.5em solid',10,10);
  boxCheck('rem','font-size:10px;border:.25rem solid',10,10);
  boxCheck('absolute','border:1pt solid',2,2);
  boxCheck('calc','font-size:10px;border:calc(.5em + 2px) solid',14,14);
  boxCheck('clamp','font-size:10px;border:clamp(2px,.5em,8px) solid',10,10);
  boxCheck('initialWidth','border:7px solid;border-width:initial',6,6);
  boxCheck('unsetStyle','border:7px solid;border-style:unset',0,0);
  boxCheck('initialShorthand','border:7px solid;border:initial',0,0);
  boxCheck('variable','--edge:4px dashed blue;border:var(--edge)',8,8);
  boxCheck('invalidVariable','border:7px solid;border-width:var(--missing)',6,6);
  boxCheck('override','border:2px solid;border-left:7px dashed',9,4);
  const parent=make('border:4px solid;padding:3px');
  const child=make('border:inherit',parent);
  let r=parent.getBoundingClientRect(), c=child.getBoundingClientRect();
  checks.inherit=close(c.width,28+variant)&&close(c.height,18);
  checks.childOffset=close(c.x-r.x,7)&&close(c.y-r.y,7);
  child.style.cssText=`width:${20+variant}px;height:10px;border-width:inherit;border-style:solid`;
  checks.inheritWidth=close(child.getBoundingClientRect().width,28+variant);
  parent.style.borderStyle='none';
  checks.inheritZero=close(child.getBoundingClientRect().width,20+variant);
  parent.style.border='4px solid';child.style.borderWidth='unset';
  checks.unsetWidth=close(child.getBoundingClientRect().width,26+variant);
  parent.style.cssText='width:100px;font-size:10px;border:.5em solid';
  child.style.cssText=`width:${20+variant}px;height:10px;font-size:20px;border:inherit`;
  checks.inheritLength=close(child.getBoundingClientRect().width,30+variant);
  parent.remove();
  const fixed=make('box-sizing:border-box;border:4px solid;padding:2px');
  r=fixed.getBoundingClientRect();checks.borderBox=close(r.width,20+variant)&&close(r.height,12);
  fixed.remove();
  const flex=make('display:flex;border:3px solid;height:20px');
  const item=make('width:8px;height:4px;flex-shrink:0;border:2px solid',flex);
  r=flex.getBoundingClientRect();c=item.getBoundingClientRect();
  checks.flex=close(r.width,26+variant)&&close(c.width,12)&&close(c.x-r.x,3);
  flex.remove();
  const generated=make('display:flex;height:auto');generated.id='generated';
  const style=document.createElement('style');
  style.textContent='#generated::before{content:"";display:block;width:10px;height:4px;border:2px solid}';
  document.head.append(style);
  checks.generated=close(generated.getBoundingClientRect().height,8);
  style.textContent='#generated::before{content:"";display:block;width:10px;height:4px;font-size:10px;border:.5em solid}';
  checks.generatedFont=close(generated.getBoundingClientRect().height,14);
  style.remove();generated.remove();
  const mutable=make('border:2px solid');
  const old=mutable.getBoundingClientRect();mutable.style.borderLeftWidth='6px';
  checks.mutation=close(mutable.getBoundingClientRect().width,28+variant)&&close(old.width,24+variant);
  mutable.style.removeProperty('border-left-width');
  checks.removal=close(mutable.getBoundingClientRect().width,25+variant);
  mutable.remove();
  return checks;
}
